business_problem: LY Corporation needed to modernize flagship consumer platforms and internal operations with AI while safely handling large volumes of user and enterprise information and maintaining trust in user-facing experiences.
solution_summary: LY Corporation built a shared OpenAI-powered foundation for both employee productivity and consumer-facing product features. Internally, the company rolled out SeekAI, an in-house tool built on the OpenAI API that uses retrieval-augmented generation over internal workspaces and documentation databases to answer employee questions quickly and reduce verification work across departments. Externally, LY uses GPT-4o in the LINE AI Assistant so users can access conversational help inside the messaging app they already use every day, and it added GPT-4 and GPT-4o features to Yahoo! JAPAN Search to summarize reviews and generate travel plans. The rollout was wrapped in governance, ethics, and employee-education controls, including zero-data-retention guarantees and clear rules around model inputs and outputs, enabling 32 production use cases by late 2024.

solution_components.name: OpenAI API
solution_components.role: Provides the model interface underlying LY Corporation’s internal and consumer AI features.

solution_components.name: SeekAI
solution_components.role: Uses retrieval-augmented generation to answer employee questions against internal workspaces and documentation.

solution_components.name: LINE AI Assistant
solution_components.role: Delivers GPT-4o-powered conversational assistance inside LINE for consumer users.

solution_components.name: Yahoo! JAPAN Search AI features
solution_components.role: Summarize reviews and generate travel plans directly in Yahoo! JAPAN Search experiences.

data_flow: Internal documents and workspace content are indexed for SeekAI, which retrieves and synthesizes answers for employees. On the consumer side, LINE and Yahoo! JAPAN user requests are routed through GPT-4-series models, and the resulting summaries or plans are refined with user feedback and LY’s product data.
business_outcome: LY Corporation created 32 AI-driven use cases, cut hundreds of thousands of work hours through internal productivity gains, improved consumer search and assistant experiences, and projected material revenue and productivity upside from AI-powered features.
